The '''freemarket''' was a wide street five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter that circled the floating platform known as [[Paragon (city)|Paragon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyed Kant]]. It contained warehouses, merchant offices, [[Bank/Legends|banks]], and public-access [[Computer/Legends|computer]] networks.
